description: Resolution lifecycle state and timestamps for one Polymarket market: initialized / posed / proposed / challenged / reproposed / disputed / resolved (or active/arbitration), whether it was disputed, the reporter (UMA_OO / Chainlink / EOA), and — once resolved — the exact resolution timestamp and per-outcome payouts. Use for "has this market actually settled yet", "when did market X resolve", "was this resolution disputed" — distinct from polymarket_market's `closed`/`active` flags, which reflect trading status, not oracle finality. Pass a market slug or numeric id (same input as polymarket_market).

slug_or_id.description: Market slug or numeric id — same input as polymarket_market.

name: polymarket_resolution_status

data_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when this response was fetched live from Polymarket Data API v2.
